Historical Evolution

15-Year Infrastructure Milestone Timeline

Tracing our trajectory from structured data center cabling to sovereign NVIDIA AI superclusters.

2011 • INCEPTION

Establishment in Dubai Silicon Oasis

Founded with specialized focus on high-density structured cabling, CommScope SYSTIMAX partner certification, and enterprise routing for initial free-zone corporate towers.

2015 • TIER-IV STORAGE EXPANSION

Banking Core Modernization & SAN Fabrics

Secured Dell Titanium and NetApp Star partnership credentials. Executed first synchronous metro disaster recovery cluster between DIFC and Abu Dhabi for top commercial banks.

2018 • REGULATORY ACCREDITATION

SIRA & MCC Official Licensure

Formally accredited by Dubai Security Industry Regulatory Agency (SIRA) and Abu Dhabi Monitoring & Control Center (MCC). Built specialized VMS staging labs for 31-day video storage compliance.

2021 • DEFENSE & CYBER BUNKER

Air-Gapped SOC & NESA Standards Implementation

Commissioned sovereign 24/7 Security Operations Center with dedicated hardware data diodes, post-quantum cryptography research, and compliance alignment with UAE Cyber Security Council decrees.

2024 • AI SUPERCOMPUTING

NVIDIA Elite Partner Status & Liquid Cooled Pods

Engineered the UAE's premier 64-GPU NVIDIA H100 research supercluster with 400G InfiniBand fabrics, sub-millisecond RoCE v2, and 60kW CDU liquid manifolds for sovereign generative AI.

2026 • PRESENT ERA

ADGM Expansion & Blackwell B200 Deployment Desk

Opened expanded capital engineering office in Al Maryah Island (ADGM), providing turn-key hardware allocations, continuous SLA monitoring, and sovereign private RAG pipelines.
